name: Children Salvation
overview: Scripture reveals that children are born in sin, as David acknowledges in Psalms 51:5, yet they are precious in the sight of Christ, who welcomes them into His kingdom (Matthew 19:14). The Bible emphasizes the importance of early spiritual training and discipline, instructing parents to lovingly guide their children in the way they should go so that they remain faithful throughout life (Proverbs 22:6; Proverbs 13:24). Ultimately, salvation is available to all who believe in Christ, highlighting the need to bring children to Him and nurture their faith from a young age (John 3:16; Matthew 18:1).
